note:
⛔ SNG-489. THREE SCHOOLS OF BODY. Erik: 'try to get to 3 schools. I like MATERIAL — could be DISCIPLINE (ki capstone) as well... thoughts or do we need 4?'
⚠️ THREE HOLDS, AND THE FOLD THAT MAKES IT WORK IS STANDING → MATERIAL. Set Word, Worth the Work and Reduction are all mason, and all three are THE CONCRETE-POLE THESIS TURNED ON PEOPLE: a mason weighing a claim is doing the same craft as a mason weighing a stone. ⛔ Reduction says so outright — it takes a person's faith down to what can be touched.

Material._what: ⛔ WHAT A THING IS AND WHAT IT WILL DO — read it, mend it, throw it, take it apart. ⚠️ AND THE SAME CRAFT TURNED ON PEOPLE: what your word is worth, what a job costs, and what is left of someone reduced to what can be weighed.
Material._absorbed: ⛔ ABSORBS STANDING. All three of Body's social crafts are mason and all three price something — a word, a job, a person. THE CONCRETE POLE DOES NOT DISTINGUISH.
Material._note: ⚠️ Nine mason and one somatic — Hurled Weight, a person USING matter rather than reading it.

Discipline._what: ⛔ THE BODY AS THE INSTRUMENT — conditioned until it stops taking harm the way bodies do, trained until it acts before the decision, and finally drawn on directly as force.
Discipline._absorbed: ⛔ ABSORBS CLOSE WORK. Erik: 'Discipline (KI CAPSTONE)'. ⚠️ Conditioning and contact-work were never two things — Perfect Motion is training that lands as a strike, Answered Motion is a strike that is really training, and KI WIELD IS THE END OF BOTH: the trained body spending itself as force.
Discipline._note: ⚠️ All somatic. The tradition's identity, its obscure, and its capstone.

Traversal._what: ⛔ GETTING THROUGH, OVER, OR OUT — ground, air, built structure, or a grip meant to hold you.
Traversal._note: ⛔ THE ONLY EVENLY-SPLIT SCHOOL: two somatic (over and out), two mason (through). ⚠️ KEPT SEPARATE DELIBERATELY — 'getting somewhere you could not' is a different verb from 'being harder to hurt' and from 'knowing what matter does', and folding it into either would hide that Body's two sects solve the same problem in opposite ways.

_balance._why3: ⚠️ ERIK ASKED WHETHER 4 WAS NEEDED. IT IS NOT. Standing folds cleanly because it is the same thesis; Close Work folds cleanly because it is the same training. ⛔ TRAVERSAL DOES NOT FOLD — it is the one school defined by a DESTINATION rather than by the body or the material, and at four skills it is small but not thin.
